dict.string: figg records your side of the meeting to transcribe it on this Mac. Audio never leaves your computer.
figg records the other people on your call to transcribe it on this Mac. Audio never leaves your computer.

figg reads your calendar (never writes it) to title meetings, suggest attendee names for speakers, and brief you before a meeting. Calendar data stays on this Mac; only meeting titles and attendee names go, as text, to the model provider you chose (AWS Bedrock by default).
